title: Cohort B Evaluate Expansion Wave 2
mission: Create and certify Evaluate-level items while proving genuine Evaluate classification quality

A-F_Taxonomy_Board.source: Pack D Section F (Technology & Analytics) REMEDIATE pool

findings.key_observation: 10 of 12 items are pure definition/classification questions with zero judgment element. Only FD-034 and FD-031 already exhibit prioritization/judgment framing.

G-L_Authoring.rationale_for_under_target: Classification quality over quantity. Only 2 Section F items had genuine Evaluate potential. Forcing upgrades on definition-recall items would produce token label changes, not genuine cognitive depth. 7 of 12 candidates would require complete stem redesign — essentially authoring new questions, beyond the Evaluate upgrade scope.

classification_notes.FD-031: Strongest — stems demand judgment among 4 competing priorities. EC explicitly weighs tradeoffs. All EW fields describe evaluation errors.
classification_notes.FD-034: Excellent — contradictory data signals create genuine diagnostic ambiguity. Candidate must cross-reference metrics and exercise professional skepticism.
classification_notes.FD-033: Adequate — stem is definition-matching (same template as 2 Understand-level clones FD-032/FD-035). EC/EW enriched with evaluation reasoning. Passes threshold but stem cognitive demand at candidate level is Analyze, not Evaluate.

pre_existing_noted: P1-FD-001: DL-008 + DL-026 (out of S854 scope)
P1-FD-006, 011, 016, 021, 026: Various DL-008/DL-026 combinations in remaining REMEDIATE pool
Pack C Section F: 15 unparseable + 42 XXXMARKER (pre-existing)

strategic_outcome.classification_quality_verified: Independent Classification Board confirmed 2/3 genuine, 0/3 false upgrades
strategic_outcome.key_insight: Only 2 of 12 Section F REMEDIATE items had natural Evaluate potential. The template-based authoring pipeline created 10 definition-recall items that would require complete stem redesign to reach Evaluate. Quality-first approach delivered fewer items with higher confidence.

revisionHistory.summary: Evaluate Expansion Wave 2: 3 items upgraded to Evaluate (2 GENUINE, 1 ADEQUATE). Independent Classification Board verified. Target of 10 not met — only 2 of 12 Section F items had natural Evaluate potential. Quality prioritized over quantity. Zero defects introduced.
